channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 27 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: First Bus Rochdale wins national Gold for Routes to Work scheme
item.description: First Bus Rochdale’s employability programme has won Gold at the UK Bus Awards after helping local young people build skills and move into work.

item.title: Six arrested after £5.9m cannabis shipment tracked to Middleton address
item.description: Six people have been arrested after police tracked a container to Heywood Old Road in Middleton during an international investigation into 590kg of cannabis.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 26 November 2026
item.description: 1 new story in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Rochdale covered as GMP marks 1,825 domestic abuse protection orders
item.description: Domestic Abuse Protection Orders are now used in every Greater Manchester Police district, including Rochdale. The force says 1,825 have been issued across Greater Manchester since the pilot began.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 25 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Littleborough farm owner seeks permission for wellness retreat with sauna and hot tub
item.description: Owners of Happy Hideaway in Littleborough have applied for retrospective planning permission to keep their sauna and hot tub retreat on agricultural land.

item.title: Letchworth Avenue, roadworks in Rochdale from 23 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Letchworth Avenue in Rochdale; expected timings: This restriction began at 9.30am on Monday, 23 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (14 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Middleton Road, roadworks in Heywood from 23 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Middleton Road in Heywood; expected timings: This restriction began on 10.30am on Monday, 23 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (15 December 2026), or when repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Police advice for Rochdale fans after substance forced Co-op Live evacuation during Don Toliver show
item.description: Anyone who went to Sunday's Don Toliver concert and has since felt unwell should go to hospital, see their GP or call 101, Greater Manchester Police say.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 24 November 2026
item.description: 7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Redwood School achieves strong standards in Ofsted inspection
item.description: Redwood School in Rochdale has received positive feedback from Ofsted, achieving strong standards in five out of seven inspection areas, including inclusion and attendance.

item.title: Wrexham U18s secure 1-0 victory over Preston North End with late goal
item.description: Wrexham U18s clinched a 1-0 win against Preston North End thanks to a stoppage-time goal from Oliver McTweed, marking a significant moment for the academy.

item.title: Heywood's £6 million active travel scheme faces criticism from local councillor
item.description: A £6 million road and transport scheme in Heywood has drawn criticism from local councillor Mike Howard, who claims it could harm the town.

item.title: Healey Lane, roadworks in Rochdale from 7 December 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Healey Lane in Rochdale; expected timings: 12midnight on Monday, 7 December 2026–11.59pm on Wednesday, 9 December 2026.

item.title: Clover Security Services Ltd to be wound up following resolutions
item.description: Clover Security Services Ltd, based in Castleton, Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up at a meeting held on 18 November 2026.

item.title: Castleton house approved for eight-bed care home
item.description: Rochdale Council has approved plans to turn a house on Thornham New Road, Castleton, into a care home for up to eight adults.

item.title: You may be able to claim for Turner Brothers asbestos
item.description: Former workers, their families and people who lived near the Spotland factory can still claim, and there are routes for people exposed elsewhere too.

item.title: Rochdale Council oversees essential services for 205,000 residents
item.description: Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council manages vital local services, including waste collection and leisure facilities, from its historic town hall in Rochdale town centre.

item.title: Free health checks in Rochdale identify 1,000 undiagnosed conditions
item.description: A community health initiative in Rochdale has revealed that half of participants were unaware they needed medical attention, with 1,000 undiagnosed conditions identified.

item.title: Daalat Ali detained twice during visit to Pakistan amid Kashmir tensions
item.description: Daalat Ali faced two detentions at Lahore airport during a visit to Pakistan, raising concerns about his safety and the political climate in Kashmir.

item.title: Rochdale AFC supports EFL's Power of 72 campaign
item.description: Rochdale AFC has joined the EFL's Power of 72 campaign, promoting mental health awareness and support for young people.

item.title: Rochdale Hornets partner with 10X Athletic for 2027 season
item.description: Rochdale Hornets have announced a partnership with 10X Athletic, naming them as the official performance nutrition partner for the 2027 season. This collaboration aims to enhance the nutritional support provided to the men's first team, ensuring players are well-prepared for their matches. As part of the partnership, 10X Athletic will supply a range of…

item.title: Temporary no waiting restriction on part of Lance Corporal Joel Halliwell VC Way in Middleton
item.description: Drivers face a temporary no waiting restriction on part of Lance Corporal Joel Halliwell VC Way in Middleton from 26 November 2026, according to a council roadworks notice.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards £152,500 contract for Lowerplace Primary School water pipework
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a £152,500 contract for hot and cold water pipework at Lowerplace Primary School to M&R Heating Services Northwest Limited.

item.title: Golden Tandoori Limited faces winding-up order in Rochdale
item.description: Golden Tandoori Limited, based in Rochdale, is subject to a winding-up order following a petition filed in the High Court.

item.title: Middleton Library to explore ghost stories and the real history behind them
item.description: Middleton Library is hosting a free evening exploring local ghost stories and the historical records behind them on Thursday 26 November 2026.

item.title: Rochdale White Ribbon vigil: where Wednesday's walk starts and how to join
item.description: Residents are invited to join a free White Ribbon Day vigil walk and service in Rochdale on Wednesday 25 November 2026, commemorating victims of violence and abuse.

item.title: Thinking about fostering? Free advice stall at Rochdale Riverside on Wednesday
item.description: People considering becoming foster carers can speak to Rochdale Borough Council's fostering team at a free information stall on Wednesday 25 November 2026.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 23 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Overwhelming support for veterans' flats plan at Denehurst House
item.description: Plans for five flats for veterans at Denehurst House have moved closer after a council consultation showed overwhelming support, with Rochdale Council's Cabinet due to decide.

item.title: Redwood School praised by Ofsted for preparing learners for next steps
item.description: Ofsted has praised Redwood School in Rochdale, a maintained school for children and young people with SEND, after a September inspection.

item.title: Football project helps girls in Rochdale tackle mental health issues
item.description: A 36-week free football programme for girls aged six to 11 waiting for or receiving Rochdale CAMHS support has begun, run by Pennine Care and Rochdale AFC Community Trust.

item.title: Rochdale schools participate in Primary Engineer Vehicle Programme to boost STEM education
item.description: Rochdale schools are participating in the Primary Engineer Vehicle Programme, aimed at enhancing STEM education by allowing students to build their own locomotives. The initiative was launched during a recent CPD training day designed to equip teachers with the skills and confidence to deliver engaging engineering projects. The training day focused on…

item.title: Rochdale Christmas light switch-on event brings festive cheer to town
item.description: The Rochdale Christmas light switch-on marked the start of the festive season in the town centre, featuring live performances and festive stalls.

item.title: Police invite parents to station over youth group's behaviour
item.description: Greater Manchester Police plan to invite the parents of a group of youths to a police station after reports of criminal damage, theft and assaults.

item.title: Middleton guitarist Adrian Abraham, 9, reaches national talent final
item.description: Nine-year-old Adrian Abraham from Middleton has been confirmed as a grand finalist in the Under 18s category of the Undiscovered Talent UK National Talent Competition.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to host York City on 14 November
item.description: Rochdale AFC will welcome York City to the Crown Oil Arena for a League Two match on Saturday 14 November, with tickets now available.

item.title: Man rescued from house fire on Abbott Street in Castleton taken to hospital
item.description: A man was rescued from a first-floor bedroom during a house fire on Abbott Street in Castleton and taken to Royal Oldham Hospital.

item.title: Rochdale AFC seeks new manager after Ian Watson's departure
item.description: Ian Watson has left his role as head coach of Rochdale AFC following a challenging start to the season, prompting speculation about potential successors.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 22 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Christmas Day bookings still available at Greater Manchester venues
item.description: Several restaurants and hotels in Greater Manchester are still accepting bookings for Christmas Day, offering a variety of festive dining options.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Saturday 21 November 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Three vehicles seized in Rochdale during police week of action on shop crime
item.description: Officers made 19 vehicle stops in Rochdale as part of Safer Business Action Week, which led to 132 arrests across Greater Manchester.

item.title: Schofield Street, roadworks in Heywood from 20 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Schofield Street in Heywood; expected timings: Work began at 8am on Friday, 20 November 2026 and will continue for a maximum of 21 days (11 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Newhey mother receives hundreds of birthday cards after son’s appeal
item.description: Wendy Bamford, 79, celebrated her birthday at Springhill Hospice, receiving an outpouring of cards and gifts following her son's heartfelt request on social media.

item.title: Rochdale Masters and Mayfield Movers raise nearly £15,000 in charity walks
item.description: The Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers have raised £14,698.67 for charity through two fundraising walks, with proceeds supporting community rugby and health initiatives.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 20 November 2026
item.description: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Tributes paid to Obesi Osi-Iyere, 20, former Cardinal Langley student
item.description: Obesi Osi-Iyere, a talented playwright and former student at Cardinal Langley RC High School, has died at the age of 20.

item.title: Photographer captures tranquil views of the Rochdale Canal at Todmorden
item.description: A photograph by cookyphil showcases the scenic beauty of the Rochdale Canal at Todmorden, highlighting its appeal for locals and visitors alike.
